referral.reason_text: Looser stools 3 months, stable; known IBS.

deciding.fast_track_met: Bowel habit change with known IBS and FIT 6 (below 10); the Hb is old, so no criterion is documented, though the change keeps it arguable.
deciding.vetting_outcome: Stable IBS-type picture argues for return, while the change in habit and an unreliable record could justify expediting.
deciding.first_contact: Stable symptoms with known IBS and a normal FIT suggest guidance by letter.
deciding.clinical_urgency: Stable for 3 months with an IBS explanation sits at level 0, but the single change in habit makes level 1 possible.
deciding.record_agreement: Exam note says warfarin which the meds list omits, and the FIT collected 2025-02-10 is after the sent date 2025-02-01; whether this counts as one or two material mismatches is open.
